intent: Connected apps page in settings (list granted client_ids, revoke button) with OAuth 2.1 grant lifecycle.
summary: Built the Connected Apps management page (PSI-075) for viewing and revoking active OAuth 2.1 grants / MCP agents. CODE: (1) src/features/connected-apps/types.ts & lib/format.ts: formatted scope labels/descriptions (OpenID, Profile, Email, Offline Access, custom scopes) and localized WIB/relative date formatting. (2) src/features/connected-apps/actions.ts: listConnectedAppsAction and revokeConnectedAppAction using Supabase auth.oauth.listGrants() and auth.oauth.revokeGrant({ clientId }). (3) src/features/connected-apps/components/: ConnectedAppsPage with info banner, loading skeleton, empty state with MCP server hint, ConnectedAppCard with client logo/uri/badges/timestamps, and RevokeAppDialog confirmation modal. (4) App router pages at /dashboard/connected-apps and /dashboard/settings/connected-apps. (5) Nav config & sidebar user menu updated with Connected Apps entry. (6) Unit tests in src/features/connected-apps/__tests__/connected-apps.test.ts (11/11 pass). VERIFIED LOCALLY: dynamic client registration -> PKCE authorization -> consent approval -> listGrants returns active grant with client metadata & scopes -> revokeGrant invalidates client -> listGrants confirms 0 active grants. Suite: 97 frontend tests pass, 15 edge function tests pass, typecheck clean, lint clean.
